newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience founder in bid for Lotus - paper.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience founder in bid for Lotus - paper.

text.p: Chris Evans, the multi-millionaire founder of biotech firm Chiroscience, has bid for British sports car group Lotus, the Mail on Sunday newspaper said.
The move by Evans may explain why last week's planned sale of Lotus to South Korean car maker Daewoo Motor Co, a unit of Daewoo Group, failed, the article said.
Daewoo was expected to pay in the region of $75 million to Romano Artioli, the chairman and owner of the group, who bought Lotus from General Motors in 1993.
Evans, whose personal wealth exceeds 60 million stg, is understood to be offering to partner Artioli and help rescue his Italian sports car business Bugatti, said the paper.
"Sources say he has promised an immediate 10 million stg cash injection, and has a team of executives standing by to move into the companies," it said.
